title: Trial by Farmer

## **[Music pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/trial-by-farmer-music-pack) HIGHLY recommended**

# Overview
**Trial by Farmer** is a modpack that combines cottagecore aesthetics, farming, and peaceful building with the danger and progression styling of more survival-oriented packs. It offers a weak-feeling early-game and mid-game experience, but nothing feels unfair and with sufficient preparation and survival skills you'll find yourself rising above the horrors of the dark.

In combination with Minecraft's data pack system, over **80** CraftTweaker script files were written to fully integrate mods with each other and make sure they follow the progression path properly. Extensive care was taken to make sure nothing feels unfinished or inconsistent.

### Key Features

- A long, thorough progression path using mechanical technology (Better with Time) heavily inspired by Valheim, Rebirth of the Night and Vintage Story

- A different world generator (Expanded Ecosphere), including features from the Spring to Life update and new mobs (LivingThings, Spring to Life Backport, Wildernature)

- A realistic skybox in both the Overworld and Paradise Lost (Astrocraft) which syncs with the in-game day and season

- Beautiful atmospherics (Better Clouds, Dynamic Surroundings, Fog, Mai)
  
- ReactiveMusic is included to enhance the fantasy vibe (the custom songpack for this pack can be found [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/trial-by-farmer-music-pack))
<details>
<summary>Survival Elements</summary>
  
- Tougher, smarter mobs (Nox: Renoxed, Zombie Awareness) that break blocks and will stop at nothing to reach you
  
- Horde nights every in-game week to test your skills (UndeadNights)
  
- A season system (Fabric Seasons) which affects crop growth, client-side cloud density and weather event frequencies, with day/night lengths changing depending on the current time of year

- Tons of new crops (Farmer's Delight, Flora Delight, Paradise Delight) with rebalanced hunger values that incentivize making more complicated dishes
  
- A dangerous mining dimension: **The Deep Underground**, with structures exclusive to the pack
</details>

<details>
<summary>Cottagecore Elements</summary>
  
- Massive amounts of block variants for building and decorating (Every Compat). Make your base cozy!
  
- Cobblemon roaming every dimension that can be battled and caught
  
- Many new foods, dishes and drinks to prepare (some of which can manipulate cobblemon spawns)

- Plenty of options for quick travel (Hang Glider, Horseshoes, Immersive Aircraft)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Compatibility/Parity Features</summary>
  
- EMI Biome icons for almost every single biome (over 180 custom-made ones)
  
- Progression is designed to slowly open up more features and options
  
- Many structures (both vanilla and modded) incorporate blocks from other mods
  
- Block, item, biome and crafting sound tags are all properly defined, including for mods that do not natively have them
  
- Modded world generation is not confined to vanilla biomes
</details>

### Notes
Trial by Farmer requires 4GB or 5GB of RAM allocated for the best experience. Also, please give the game around 20 seconds to first load into new worlds.


<details>
<summary>Credits</summary>

The required resource pack contains derivatives of textures from Farmer's Delight, specifically for recoloring blocks/items to match their changed recipes. This project uses the [MIT license](https://choosealicense.com/licenses/mit/). Additionally, some textures from Better With Time (a mod included in the pack) were edited for use on other items (this mod is under  [CC-BY-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)).

Custom EMI icons are derivative of the icons on the Minecraft Wiki, licensed under [CC BY-NC-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/).
</details>
